headline: A 2006 executive order hands certain federal pay-related duties from the President to other officials.
what_it_does: This order assigns, or delegates, some pay-related tasks that the law gives to the President to other officials or agencies. The title does not say which pay duties are covered or who receives them. No summary was provided, so the details are not known from this source.

who_it_affects.how: Some decisions about their pay may be handled by a different official or agency instead of the President.

when_it_takes_effect: Likely upon signing, December 1, 2006 (not confirmed by the source)
